findings.citation: Apart from items 4–6, the existing room, token and admin endpoints keep their behavior (status codes, response fields, auth, `409` for an enabled live duplicate, regenerate-code, session-history rejoin).
findings.description: The checks validate successful token endpoint status codes but never validate its response fields (`url`, `token`, and `room`), so that part of the preservation contract can regress undetected.

findings.citation: a replicated rename keeps the old name live on both backends
findings.description: The check compares `bAfterOneWay`, `aLive`, and `bLive` as ordered arrays such as `["den","family"]`, while the instruction explicitly says snapshot record order is free. The scenario's `liveNames` helper does not sort before comparison, so a valid implementation emitting the same records in another order is rejected.
